create_bijector_subclass: create a Bijector subclass implementing forward_and_log_det for a custom differentiable transformation
implement_forward_and_log_det: implement forward_and_log_det to compute y=f(x) and log|det J(f)(x)| in a bijector subclass
implement_inverse_and_log_det: implement inverse_and_log_det to compute x=f inverse(y) and its log Jacobian determinant
use_forward_method: use the forward method to compute y=f(x) from a bijector instance
use_inverse_method: use the inverse method to compute x=f inverse(y) from a bijector instance
